title: Foster + Partners Completes Addition to Bilbao Fine Arts Museum
summary: The British design studio Foster + Partners and Bilbao architect Luis María Uriarte have expanded the Bilbao Fine Arts Museum in Spain, with an 180-foot-long elevated gallery. title: Phoenix Art Museum Receives a $5 Million Gift For Its Asian Art Wing
summary: The Phoenix Art Museum has received a $5 million gift from the philanthropist Dr. Sukumar Nagendran. The money will support acquisitions, scholarly research, and public programming, focused primarily on South Asian and Sri Lankan art. The expansion includes an increase of the museum’s Art of Asia galleries from 6,000 square feet to 10,000 square feet. […]
